findings.detail: M3.6's named cases sit inside an async describe that awaits a dist import; node --test with a name pattern reports 0 tests, so the m3-complete leg can never pass.
findings.failure_scenario: m3-complete stays red on this leg at M3.25; Node versions may disagree.

findings.detail: CommandDef/executeCommand carry no TxOptions (origin, mergeKey, metaBefore/After); the only production write path cannot merge a drag or carry undo meta.
findings.failure_scenario: The editor's drag through executeCommand('element.update') gives 60 undo entries without view meta; the merge title passes on raw store.transact in a test.

findings.detail: Every transaction copies the record map and runs validateReferences over the whole document, contradicting ADR-0014 Consequences; the M3.23 row does not require benches with validation on, and transact-5000 has no leg.
findings.failure_scenario: Benches pass with validate:false while dev/test drags and undo do an O(5000) scan.

findings.detail: element.update/document.update accept fields that change id/type (patch throws); document.update throws without a document; screen.reorder with an unknown after returns TX_INVALID without a diagnostic.
findings.failure_scenario: An MCP client gets an uncaught error instead of a diagnostic.

findings.detail: sameChanges compares by reference; an idempotent hook that re-writes an equal value never converges.
findings.failure_scenario: A normalising plugin hook makes every transaction TX_HOOK_DEPTH.

findings.detail: The architecture test skips apps/*; check-kind-switch skips layout, routing, anim, dsl, sdk, mcp, cli, packs and apps.
findings.failure_scenario: routing adds an if-chain on connector kinds and stays green.

findings.detail: M3.2 F2/F3 argued decisions (fork.diffFrom base and apply; empty-diff merge rule) are not in the M3.22/M3.20 acceptance.
findings.failure_scenario: diffFrom is never implemented and the gate goes green.

dispositions.note: Named cases discoverable under a name pattern (no async describe); 03 case in M3.24 kept out of it.
Rows amended: executeCommand carries TxOptions into run; merging and undo meta tested through element.update.
Row amended: benches use default store options (validation on), a transact-5000 leg, ADR-0014 Consequences amended to the real cost.
Built-ins return diagnostics for identity changes, a missing document and an unknown after.
Both gates scan every package, pack and app that can consume kinds or write.
Rows amended: M3.20 decides the empty-diff merge rule with a test; M3.22 implements and tests fork.diffFrom.

planDelta: 25 -> 26 rows (M3.26 cp1 fixes) and four amended rows; 26/16 = 1.63x the plan, mostly M2 harness hand-offs and review-driven hardening: harness debt still spills into product milestones.
